headline: Caring is a verb.
sub: A chair pulled in. A cup of tea. Forty minutes on a Tuesday.
content:
Most of us love our parents. That was never the question.

The question is when someone last sat with her. Caring is something you do — a chair pulled in, a cup of tea, forty minutes on a Tuesday.

GranWatch simply shows the whole family, kindly, whether anyone has. She doesn't need a phone; the family carries it for her.

For those who truly care. granwatch.app
notes: Belief 1: caring is a verb. Feature (no phone) sits in the last line, never leads.
